risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (369.28), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and earnings in 35 days create a highly adverse macro backdrop for ED.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with supertrend bullish and RSI extreme overbought suggests strong momentum structure, while extreme fear (17/100) presents classic contrarian buy opportunity in crisis VIX environment.
